GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 383.6 (9 Sep 46) GB/CIS
(SCAPIN - 1191)
APO 500
9 September 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo ,
SUBJECT : Release of Internee
1. SHIONO, Suehiko, incarcerated in Sugarmo Prison 1 December 1945 was released unconditionally 9 September 1946.
2. The Imperial Japanese Government will therefore make the proper notations in its records.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant Genoral.
